service.description: A purchase receipt's received lines bought for customer-order demand, each with the sales line it was bought for (through the line's RequirementSupply: the requirement's customer order lines, and the purchase request line's RequestItemOrder sales lines), what of that line is still to ship, waits for stock (reserved but not available, or not reserved) and is reserved on the received stock, and whether the user may reserve it now (STOCK_RECEIVE, the stock available or on hold for its putaway and on hand, something waiting). Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT or STOCK_RECEIVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a shipment that is not a purchase receipt of the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Reserve stock received on a purchase receipt for the sales line its purchase line was bought for: what is not available of the line's reservations, up to the stock's quantity on hand, is taken off (reduce#AssetReservation) and the line is reserved with the received stock first (mantle.product.AssetServices.reserve#AssetForOrderItem with the asset, which displaces other reservations of it as needed). A line with nothing waiting answers alreadyReserved. Requires STOCK_RECEIVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a shipment that is not a purchase receipt of the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), stock not received on it (ASSET_UNAVAILABLE), a sales line the purchase line was not bought for (NOT_PEGGED), stock held for inspection (STOCK_HELD) and stock no longer on hand (STOCK_UNAVAILABLE). Stock on hold for its putaway is reserved, so the pegged line is first to it when putaway makes it available.
